title: Warm Buttery Saudi Arabian Sweet Rice Flour Bake
description: A traditional Saudi Arabian dessert featuring sweet rice flour, baked to perfection in a wood-fired oven and topped with melted butter, this dish is sugar-free friendly and perfect for cozy nights.
instructions: Preheat the wood-fired oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the sweet rice flour, salt, and vanilla extract.
Add the melted butter, eggs, and water to the bowl and mix until a smooth batter forms.
Pour the batter into a greased 9x13 inch baking dish.
Drizzle the ghee or oil over the top of the batter.
Bake for 35 minutes or until the top is golden brown and the center is set.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes.
Serve warm, topped with additional melted butter if desired.
